title: Setup and Studio: suggestions from the 18.3.0 RC browser walkthrough: Setup naming and machine values, invitation and user onboarding, permission-set authoring, dialog focus, Studio first run, validation and flow builders, and publish-panel wording
body:
domain:devx#1 · sunhaolin · session_017xRBcUoS2G4jgqRskpExS7

Suggestions from the 18.3.0 release-candidate browser walkthrough (wave anchor #27377, card W3-UX, tracks 2 and 3). Everything was observed at framework `main` @ `c4c515ad`, with the Console built in-repo from that commit, on stock `examples/app-showcase` with `--seed-admin`.

- **Personas:** the seeded admin; a plain member made through the real invite → accept-invitation → register path; two admin-created users.
- **Viewports:** desktop 1440×900 and phone 390×844.
- **Studio:** authored in a new package created from Home → **New in Studio**.

Each row works today but could be clearer. The reproducible defects from the same pass are their own cards: #27483, #27487, #27491, #27494, #27496, #27498, #27502 (Console); #27504, #27506, #27507, #27509 (Setup); #27511, #27513, #27515, #27517, #27518, #27519 (Studio).

## Setup

| # | Observed at c4c515ad (persona, viewport, path) | Suggestion |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Admin, desktop. The Setup app has four names: "System Settings" (Home link), "Setup" (app header), "Settings" (app switcher), "Settings" (hub). | One name everywhere. |
| 2 | Admin, desktop, Settings. Help text and badges leak machine values: `invite_only` / `email_domain` / `open`, `OS_AUTH_REQUIRE_EMAIL_V…`, "recorded in sys_email", `sys_ai_trace`, `OS_FEATURE_FLAGS_AI_ENABLED`, a "Tenant" badge, and the Webhooks subtitle "defineStack({ webhooks }) / defineWebhook() … webhook auto-enqueuer". | Business wording, with the technical detail behind "learn more". |
| 3 | Admin, desktop, Settings. The sidebar says "Email" while the hub card says "Mail Delivery". SMS Delivery and Data Lifecycle are on the hub but missing from the sidebar. | Same names and the same set in both. |
| 4 | Admin, desktop, System Overview and Notifications. The legend shows `config_change`. The topic `approval.requested` and object `sys_approval_request` appear raw. Severity "info" is drawn as an orange badge. The audit object `sys_metadata_activation` appears raw, and Users carry an "Env-Native" badge. | Labels for topics, objects and sources; a neutral colour for info. |
| 5 | Admin, desktop. Sharing Rules and Webhooks with zero rows say "No matching records — No records match this view's filter", while Queues says "Nothing here yet — Create your first record". The header tags ("Admin config", "Platform schema", "System-managed", "Identity") are unexplained. | Empty states that say "none yet" plus how to add one; a tooltip on each tag. |
| 6 | Admin, desktop, Invitations → Invite. The toast says "Invitation sent to …" although the stock deployment has no mail transport, and there is no **Copy invite link** in the row menu or the detail drawer, so the invite dead-ends. | "Invitation created — copy the link to share it" when no mail provider is configured, plus a Copy link action. |
| 7 | Admin, desktop, Invitations. The status values are raw lowercase (pending / accepted / canceled …), while the tabs are title case. | Use the labels. |
| 8 | Admin, desktop, Invite dialog. The Role help text differs by entry point ("Member role within the organization" vs "Role to assign upon acceptance"), and neither explains Owner / Admin / Delegated Admin / External. **Change Role**'s description is the generic "Please provide the required information to continue." and does not name the person. | One help text, with a line per role; name the person in Change Role. |
| 9 | Admin, desktop, Invitations row menu. **Resend** opens an editable Email/Role form. The Cancel Invitation dialog's two buttons read "Cancel" and "Cancel Invitation". | Resend as a confirm; "Keep invitation" / "Cancel invitation". |
| 10 | Admin, desktop. Invite with an invalid email is not checked client-side, and "Invalid email" shows twice, as a banner and a toast, with the field unmarked. Create User with Email empty says "Either email or phoneNumber is required" (`phoneNumber` is an API key, and the form has no phone field), and the form shows no required asterisks. | Inline field errors only; "Email is required"; asterisks as in the Invite dialog. |
| 11 | Invitee, desktop. The plain sign-in page has no hint for invited people. The invite registration form does not pre-fill the invited email. After accepting there is no "you joined" confirmation. | Pre-fill the email; a short welcome after joining. |
| 12 | Admin, desktop, Create User with a typed password. The dialog still says "If a temporary password was generated, copy it now". On the user's forced-change screen, "Current password" would read better as "Temporary password", and the title and body repeat. | Show the copy line only when one was generated; "Temporary password". |
| 13 | Admin, desktop, a user record. Details shows only created/updated, so the saved Locale is invisible. There is no Banned badge or ban reason. "Platform Role: user" is lowercase. The tab strip is cut at 1440 with no overflow cue. | Show Locale, ban state and reason; a label for the platform role; scroll the tab strip with a cue. |
| 14 | Admin, desktop, user record → Permission Sets tab. It shows the API name `organization_admin_no_bypass`, a set auto-granted on the role change to Admin with no message. | Show the label; say on the role change what it grants. |
| 15 | Admin, desktop, Users list. Row actions appear only on hover, so the Actions column looks empty. There is no status or role column, so a banned user looks like everyone else. | A visible ⋯; Status and Role columns. |
| 16 | Admin, desktop, New Permission Set. The snake_case **Name** comes first, with Label second and optional, and Name is not derived from Label. A bad name stacks three messages, including "is not a legal metadata item name" and "does not match the spec — 1 validation error(s)". | Label first, Name derived from it; one plain message. |
| 17 | Admin, desktop and phone, permission set editor. The grid needs sideways scroll at 1440, and the Bulk column is cut with no cue. On a phone the Object column is not sticky. Two fields are both labelled "Owner". With field rows expanded, the header labels do not line up with the columns. | Sticky first column, overflow cue, disambiguated labels, aligned headers. |
| 18 | Admin, desktop, permission set → Add user. The picker lists names only (the same pattern as #27356 row 2 for positions). | Show the email beside the name. |
| 19 | Admin, desktop, Company settings. Country is case-sensitive with maxlength 2: "de" is refused, and "Germany" silently becomes "Ge" and is refused `(got "Ge")`. Locale and Timezone are free text. Save feedback is otherwise good. | Pickers for country, locale and timezone. |
| 20 | Admin, desktop and phone, Packaged Automation. The switches change state instantly with no confirmation or toast, including for platform-critical actions such as Ban User. The Object column shows API names. On a phone the Activation column and Clone button are clipped. | A confirm for platform actions and a toast after each switch; object labels; a phone layout. |
| 21 | Admin, desktop, Packages. The showcase (code) package has no Disable button and no reason. Platform packages say "platform kernel package". Disabling an authored package applies with no confirmation, and its delete button says "Delete app" while everything else says "package". Installed Apps reuses the Packages subtitle. | Say why a package cannot be disabled; confirm Disable; consistent nouns. |
| 22 | Admin-created user with locale fr-FR, desktop. The forced-change screen's title and labels are French but the body is English ("You must change your password before continuing."). A wrong current password says English "Invalid password". The Home feed reads `Updated User "Carl Edited": Banned et Ban Reason`. The Locale help says it is the "Preferred language for this user's notifications", but it switches the whole UI. | Translate the remaining strings; correct the Locale help text. |
| 23 | Admin, desktop, Invite User and Create User dialogs. On open, focus lands on **Cancel** with no visible ring. After Esc or Done, focus goes to `body` rather than back to the button that opened the dialog. Tab order and Esc are otherwise correct. | Initial focus on the first field; return focus to the opener. |

## Studio

| # | Observed at c4c515ad (persona, viewport, path) | Suggestion |
|---|---|---|
| 24 | Admin, desktop, Home → New in Studio → New Package. The dialog speaks to developers: "reverse-domain notation", "Object namespace", "SemVer 2.0.0", "Type: app", and the default ID `com.default.field-service`. The landing copy mentions a "writable base" and an "environment overlay". The "Start with your first object" step after it is clear. | A name-only first step with the technical fields behind "Advanced". |
| 25 | Admin, desktop, Picklist options editor. The monospace `value` box comes before Label and is not filled from the label (object and field names are). With three labelled options visible, the banner still says the field "needs at least one option". Each option has a "No kind" dropdown offering sales-only kinds (Open / Won / Lost). | Label first with the value derived; clear the banner once options exist; hide the kind unless the field drives a path. |
| 26 | Admin, desktop, Validations → Reject the save when…. Fields are listed as `record.estimated_hours` without labels, and the placeholder is "field / context". The form reads "Script — CEL fail condition", "Rule name (snake_case, unique)" with default `validation_1`, and "error (rejects the save)". The list-view filter in the same product shows labels. | Field labels in the picker; a rule name derived from the message; business wording. |
| 27 | Admin, desktop, a record-triggered flow → Update Records node. It does not offer "the record that started this flow"; the author must know to type `id` with expression `record.id`. Object is not pre-filled with the trigger object, and keys are free text. A blank expression shows "A value carrying a `dialect` key is read as an expression envelope… Write `{ dialect: 'cel', source: '…' }`" while Problems says "No problems — this flow is structurally valid." | A "Triggering record" target; pre-fill the object; field pickers; business wording. |
| 28 | Admin, desktop, Publish panel. Items list raw keys ("+ label + name + sharingModel", "+ config + isDefault + viewKind", "+ fieldGroups + validations" without naming the rule, "+ edges + nodes + status"), and the copy says "atomically" / "(one atomic release)". This widens #27356 row 17 beyond flows. | Name what changed in words ("New view Work Order list", "Validation rule Hours over 40"). |
| 29 | Admin, desktop. Toasts appear top-centre over the object or flow header, covering the name badge, the tabs and the Enable switch. | Bottom or right placement in Studio. |
| 30 | Admin, desktop at 1440. The flow header reads "Trigger: Reco… · Status: Unpu…". Node cards show "START field_service_work_…". The Interfaces rail shows `field_service_work_order....`, and its header truncates to "FIELD SERVICE · N…". | Labels instead of API names; wrap or widen. |
| 31 | Admin, desktop, Interfaces. The list-view inspector edits only the default grid; there is no way to create a kanban, calendar or other view type. | An "Add view" with a type choice. |
| 32 | Admin, desktop, object header and form groups. "Scheduling 1 fields". The header says "10 fields" while the canvas shows 2: system fields are counted but not explained. | Pluralise; "2 fields (+8 system)". |
| 33 | Admin, desktop, Add field popover. A disabled **Create** has no reason and is skipped by Tab. Focus trap, Esc and the inspector's Tab order are otherwise good. | A reason tooltip, focusable when disabled. |
| 34 | Admin, desktop, the read-only showcase package in Studio. It is clearly marked (Read-only chip and banner), but disabled textareas and some number inputs keep live styling, and Publish has no reason tooltip. | Muted styling on disabled inputs; a reason on Publish. |
| 35 | Admin, desktop, after the first publish. Nothing tells the author that members cannot use the new app. The member then sees a good message ("Nothing in Field Service is available to you yet… Ask an administrator to assign you a permission set"). | Point the publish toast to Access. |
| 36 | Admin, desktop, formula field editor. A bare textarea with no field picker. Syntax errors are technical ("Unexpected token: EOF … ^"), and the error line sits under the sticky Remove button. The unknown-field "did you mean `estimated_hours`?" is good. | A field picker and plain error text kept clear of the sticky footer. |
| 37 | Admin, phone. The pillar switcher is icon-only, and the package name truncates to "Fie…". There is an honest "Studio is built for a desktop screen." and no horizontal scroll. | Labels under the icons. |
| 38 | Member, desktop, any Studio URL. "You need Studio access to open Studio." with Back to home. It is clean. | Say who grants it (an administrator, in Setup → Permission Sets). |
| 39 | Admin, desktop, Add node menu. Node help is engine prose: HTTP "`durable: true`… outbox… dead-letter", Connector "registerConnector()", Revise Window "back-edge". This widens #27356 row 15 to the Add node menu. | Business wording, with the detail behind "learn more". |

## Already carded: not raised again

Rows of #27356 still reproducing at c4c515ad: 1 (Create User permission set as free text), 3 (a green switch beside "Not running here" naming an env var; now also #27378), 5 (singular titles, API name first), 6 (no Deactivate in the Users row menu), 7 ("Record ID" column shows a name), 9 (`__search` first in field overrides), 11 (Setup All reports empty state), 12 (Studio reachable only from Home), 13 (overlay label shown, breadcrumb lands on All Metadata Types), 14 (no fields table), 15 (engine prose in flow help; see row 39), 17 (publish dialog wording; see row 28). Row 22 (phone flow canvas fit-to-view) did not reproduce with a 3-node flow, which is inconclusive for larger flows. The invitation status path drawing "canceled" as a later step belongs to the #26612 family.

## Acceptance

Each row is either taken, with its own card if it needs one, or answered "will not do" with the reason.
